items.title: Dell's revenue guidance exceeded Wall Street forecasts and then some
items.summary: Dell Technologies stock (DELL) is jumping Wednesday morning after the computer company blew past fiscal full-year guidance forecasts. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the positive stock reaction to Dell's latest earnings release.

items.summary: The chipmaking giant's valuation can't go down forever.

items.title: Can AMD's Saudi AI Buildout Challenge NVIDIA and Broadcom?
items.summary: AMD is scaling its Saudi AI push with HUMAIN, targeting 250 MW from 2027 and up to 1 GW by 2030 as it challenges NVIDIA and Broadcom.

items.title: MongoDB Beat Every Estimate and Raised Guidance, Then Lost 13.6% in a Single Session
items.summary: MongoDB crushed estimates and lifted guidance, then watched investors punish the stock anyway. The reason comes down to a single line buried in the earnings report that separates what the company reported from what it actually earned.

items.title: Chevron Just Committed $7 Billion to Venezuela. Here's What It Means for CVX Stock.
items.summary: Chevron just doubled down on Venezuela right after Washington cut an oil deal there. Will this bet pay off?

items.title: Nvidia Did the Heavy Lifting for the Major Market Indexes Today
items.summary: The major indexes rose about 0.4% Wednesday. Nvidia and Meta Platforms did nearly all of the work. Here's the math behind the quiet tape.

items.title: Sandisk Stock: Buy, Sell, or Hold?
items.summary: Sandisk has been crushing the S&P 500, and recent news from peer memory maker Samsung could extend its rally.

items.title: Musk’s $30 Trillion AI Forecast Hinges on a Timeline Even NVIDIA Says Is Unrealistic
items.summary: Elon Musk told G20 leaders that AI and robotics will add up to $30 trillion a year to the global economy, naming a specific deadline. The supply chain constraints binding even NVIDIA suggest the math only works if you ignore how long industrial revolutions actually take.
